units.source_text: 我没有留意，正向漱清殿走去的一男一女竟发生了口角。

en.t: Before I noticed it, a man and a woman who were walking toward the Soseiden had started quarreling.

units.source_text: 争吵越来越激烈，可我一句话也没有听清楚。

en.t: The quarrel grew more and more heated, but I could not make out a single word.

units.source_text: 女人也用强硬的语言回敬了他，但不知她是说英语还是日语。

en.t: The woman answered him back in forceful words as well, but I could not tell whether she was speaking English or Japanese.

units.source_text: 两人边争吵边走，早已把我的存在忘却了，又折回法水院来了。

en.t: Still quarreling as they walked, the two had long since forgotten I was there, and they turned back toward the Hossuiin.
